files_changed.summary: added SupabaseURL (default http://127.0.0.1:54321) and SupabaseAnonKey env fields
added errs.New(status, message) for domain code constructing an explicit status
documented supabase.go as a dev-only addition outside §5.6's real scope, cross-referenced to this task folder
SupabaseClient.Login: stdlib net/http POST to GoTrue password grant; 5xx -> plain error (500), other non-200 -> errs.New(401)
httptest fake GoTrue server; success, invalid-credentials, bad-request cases
NewRouter now takes config.Config; wires POST /v1/auth/login
passes cfg to NewRouter; logs a warning if SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is unset

decisions: No interface introduced between handler and auth.SupabaseClient — one implementation, so the concrete type is used directly and tested by pointing BaseURL at an httptest.Server (ponytail: no interface for one implementation).

Collapsed all non-200 GoTrue responses to a generic 401 'invalid credentials' (except 5xx -> 500) rather than passing through Supabase's error body, to avoid leaking GoTrue's internal error shape/enumeration through this proxy.
commands_run: go run ./cmd/gateway + curl /healthz, curl /v1/auth/login with a malformed body (400) and a well-formed one (401, since SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is unset and the local Supabase instance on :54321 rejected it) — process terminated cleanly after
